question: What does the acronym SMPS stand for? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (08/02/2021) Shift 2)
options: Single-Mode Power Supply
Store-Mode Power Supply
Switched-Mode Power Supply
Start-Mode Power Supply
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Switched-Mode Power Supply

Explanation:
SMPS stands for Switched-Mode Power Supply. It is a high-efficiency power supply that uses a switching regulator to convert input voltage to the desired output voltage. Compared to traditional linear power supplies, it is smaller, lighter, and more efficient. It is widely used in computers, televisions, chargers, and other electronic devices. SMPS uses MOSFETs or transistors for fast switching, reducing energy loss.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ SMPS full form → Switched-Mode Power Supply
☛ Main component used in SMPS → MOSFET or transistor
☛ Efficiency of SMPS → 80-90% (higher than linear supply)
☛ Application of SMPS → Computers, chargers, TVs, adapters
☛ Advantage of SMPS → Light weight, compact size, high efficiency

Explanation:
SMPS का पूरा नाम स्विच्ड-मोड पॉवर सप्लाई (Switched-Mode Power Supply) है। यह एक उच्च-दक्षता वाली पावर सप्लाई है जो स्विचिंग रेगुलेटर का उपयोग करके इनपुट वोल्टेज को आवश्यक आउटपुट वोल्टेज में बदलती है। पारंपरिक लीनियर पावर सप्लाई की तुलना में यह छोटी, हल्की और अधिक कुशल होती है। इसका उपयोग कंप्यूटर, टेलीविजन, चार्जर और अन्य इलेक्ट्रॉनिक उपकरणों में व्यापक रूप से किया जाता है। SMPS में MOSFET या ट्रांजिस्टर का उपयोग करके तेजी से स्विचिंग की जाती है, जिससे ऊर्जा हानि कम होती है।

question: The famous explorer _________ wanted to come to India, but instead landed on the shores of America. (RRB NTPC CBT-I (09/02/2021) Shift 1)
options: Genghis Khan
Vasco de Gama
Alexander
Christopher Columbus
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Christopher Columbus

Explanation:
Christopher Columbus was an Italian explorer who worked under the patronage of the Spanish monarchs. He set out to find a western sea route to Asia (India). In 1492, he crossed the Atlantic Ocean and reached the Caribbean islands (Bahamas). He believed he had arrived in India, so he called the native inhabitants 'Indians.' In reality, he had landed on the shores of America. Columbus made four voyages but never realized he had discovered a new continent. This event marked the beginning of European colonization and the Columbian Exchange.

☛ Year of Columbus's first voyage → 1492
☛ Under whose patronage did Columbus sail? → King Ferdinand and Queen Isabella of Spain
☛ First island Columbus landed on → Bahamas (San Salvador)
☛ Who correctly identified Columbus's discovery as a new continent? → Amerigo Vespucci
☛ Islands named after India → West Indies

question: Where is the headquarters of Oil and Natural Gas Corporation located in India? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (09/02/2021) Shift 1)
options: Rajasthan
Jharkhand
Uttarakhand
Mumbai
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Uttarakhand

Explanation:

ONGC was established in 1956 and operates under the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas. The company is involved in exploration, production, and marketing of crude oil and natural gas. ONGC contributes approximately 70% of India's total oil production and around 80% of its natural gas production. While it has significant offices in Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, and Ahmedabad, its corporate headquarters remains in Dehradun, Uttarakhand.

question: What is the full form of PDF in the context of file formats? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (09/02/2021) Shift 1)

solution:

question: The researchers at which of the following institutes have designed and booted up India's first indigenously-developed microprocessor that can be used in mobile computing devices? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (09/02/2021) Shift 1)
options: IIT Delhi
IIT Roorkee
IIT Madras
IIT Kanpur
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is IIT Madras

Explanation:
India's first indigenously developed microprocessor, named RISE (RISC-V based Indigenous Educational Microprocessor), has been designed and booted up by researchers at IIT Madras. This microprocessor is based on the RISC-V open-source architecture and is developed for use in mobile computing devices. The processor is fabricated using 180 nm technology and operates at speeds up to 100 MHz. This achievement marks a significant step towards India's self-reliance in semiconductor design. The project has received support under the Prime Minister's indigenous initiative.

question: India is an associate member of _________. (RRB NTPC CBT-I (09/02/2021) Shift 1)

solution:

Explanation:

question: Who developed the concept of 'human development'? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (09/02/2021) Shift 1)

question: Which of the following universities designed and built the first electronic computer (ENIAC)? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (09/02/2021) Shift 1)
options: University of Pennsylvania
University of Stanford
University of Oxford
University of Harvard
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is University of Pennsylvania

Explanation:

It was constructed by John Presper Eckert and John Mauchly. Completed in 1945, ENIAC is considered the first general-purpose electronic computer. It contained 17,468 vacuum tubes and could perform 5,000 additions per second. This machine was a milestone in the history of computing.

question: Which of the following is the currency of Italy? (RRB JE ME (30/08/2019) Shift 1 CBT 2)
options: Rupee

Dinar
Euro
solution:
